segments.title: Big News Dump: Bears at Red Rocks, Diddy Verdict, Alex Jones Tears, YouTube AI Slop Policy

segments.title: Skyentist Reports Earth Spinning Faster

segments.title: Jeb Nogget: Male Modeling Poses and Competitive Sauna (Aufguss)

segments.title: Burger vs Hot Dog Debate; Love Island Sierra Racism Accountability Video

segments.title: DJ Newsic Finale: Resident Evil 9 Rap, Zombie Guest, Chat Shoutouts

episode_summary: Barely Informed News returned from holiday break with a marathon broadcast covering the Epstein file fallout, Grok AI's Nazi meltdown, and a viewer-video Amongst the Web. The second half featured a science segment on Earth's accelerating rotation, Jeb Nogget's post-reconstruction modeling and sauna tutorial, and a chaotic Munch & Crum where Crum's voice modulator and Munch's hell-retrieval refusal dominated a burger-hot dog debate before pivoting to Love Island racism discourse. DJ Newsic closed with a Resident Evil 9 rap and zombie interview.
